message:
The users test passes now. `npm test` shows 1 passed and 0 failed.

The cause was a column name mismatch. Migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` used `full_name`. I changed the API to use `fullname` in `createUser` and `getUser`. I didn't touch `migrations/`, since the DBA team owns it. The change is two lines in `src/api/users.js`.
